subtasks.goal: Handle reservation R2087 for passenger Dana Whitfield (SFO to ORD, currently scheduled 2026-08-03) end to end: (1) Look up reservation R2087 to find the current segment, the cabin she is booked in, and the fare she paid. (2) Look up the passenger's frequent-flyer tier. (3) Search flights from SFO to ORD on 2026-08-03 and identify the earliest departing flight that day that is still scheduled and has at least one seat remaining in the same cabin Dana is currently booked in (do not change her cabin). (4) Read the fare rules for that cabin to determine the change fee and how fare differences are handled, and check if Dana's frequent-flyer tier is exempt from the change fee. (5) Change reservation R2087 onto the identified earliest qualifying flight, keeping the same cabin. (6) Settle what she owes: if her tier is not exempt from the change fee, charge the change fee as a change_fee charge; if the new flight's fare in that cabin is higher than what she originally paid, charge the difference as a fare_difference charge (never charge a fee to an exempt tier, and never refund if the new fare is cheaper). Only touch reservation R2087 throughout.
